name: Melanoma Nuclei and Tissue Segmentation Dataset
description: A dataset and baseline benchmarks for nuclei and tissue segmentation in melanoma histopathology images.
evaluation_method: Dice coefficient (F1) and Intersection over Union (mean IoU); may also report pixel-wise accuracy and IOU per class
reputation: Used within computational pathology and medical imaging research for melanoma histopathology segmentation; moderate adoption in that niche.
notes: Medical imaging benchmark with expert annotations; potential class imbalance and staining/slide variability; relatively small dataset compared to large public vision corpora; non-LLM task requiring specialized preprocessing and GPU resources.
